getServerSideProps - When should I use
text_content:
You should use `` if you need to render a page that relies on personalized user data, or information that can only be known at request time. For example, `` headers or a geolocation.
If you do not need to fetch the data at request time, or would prefer to cache the data and pre-rendered HTML, we recommend using [/docs/pages/building-your-application/data-fetching/get-static-props](/docs/pages/building-your-application/data-fetching/get-static-props).

title: getServerSideProps - Behavior
text_content:
`` runs on the server.
`` can only be exported from a page.
`` returns JSON.
When a user visits a page, `` will be used to fetch data at request time, and the data is used to render the initial HTML of the page.
`` passed to the page component can be viewed on the client as part of the initial HTML. This is to allow the page to be [https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/hydrate](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/hydrate) correctly. Make sure that you don't pass any sensitive information that shouldn't be available on the client in ``.
When a user visits the page through [/docs/pages/api-reference/components/link](/docs/pages/api-reference/components/link) or [/docs/pages/api-reference/functions/use-router](/docs/pages/api-reference/functions/use-router), Next.js sends an API request to the server, which runs ``.
You do not have to call a Next.js [/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/api-routes](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/api-routes) to fetch data when using `` since the function runs on the server. Instead, you can call a CMS, database, or other third-party APIs directly from inside ``.
Good to know:See [/docs/pages/api-reference/functions/get-server-side-props](/docs/pages/api-reference/functions/get-server-side-props) for parameters and props that can be used with ``.You can use the [https://next-code-elimination.vercel.app/](https://next-code-elimination.vercel.app/) to verify what Next.js eliminates from the client-side bundle.

title: getServerSideProps - Error Handling
text_content: If an error is thrown inside ``, it will show the `` file. Check out the documentation for [/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-error#500-page](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-error#500-page) to learn more on how to create it. During development, this file will not be used and the development error overlay will be shown instead.
